name: A2 with 3×3 neighbour shrinkage
selected_by: rule 1: the simplest candidate within 2% of the best pooled weighted CRPS (pixel unit)
frozen_setting_note: chosen by inner leave-one-year-out over 2012-2019 on the 17 development regions in the final fit; a new region is refitted on its own 2012-02..2019-12 rows with this setting and nothing is tuned

refit.code: pipeline.tournament.candidates.fit('C5', T, train, scored, years, label, setting=<frozen_setting>) on a one-region table built by pipeline.tournament.data.rows + pipeline.round2.data.build_table
refit.rows: cell x month x day/night from 2012-02 for every cell with a MODIS, Suomi NPP or NOAA-20 detection in 2012-02..2019-12; FIRMS standard; type 0; MODIS confidence >= 30; VIIRS confidence n/h; region box from pipeline/regions.py; Y = Terra + Aqua

classes.frp: f0 FRP <= 0, f1 0 < FRP < 5, f2 5 <= FRP < 20, f3 FRP >= 20 MW
classes.scan: s0 scan < 0.5, s1 0.5 <= scan <= 0.65, s2 scan > 0.65 km

noaa20.s: sum V_SNPP / sum V_N20 per region x day/night; month-block bootstrap

refit.outage_rule: bake-off rule (pipeline.bakeoff.data.outages) over the included regions combined

burning_days_model.name: FRP-class A2 ratios
burning_days_model.unit_definition: a 0.01 degree cell (floor(lon/0.01), floor(lat/0.01)) counts once per date and day/night if it has any detection of the family (MODIS = Terra + Aqua); cell-day counts summed per 0.25 degree cell x month x day/night; a burning day takes the FRP and scan classes of its largest-FRP detection

open_question: The plan does not say which model sits the round-3 exam when burning days are adopted as the primary unit: the pixel champion of rule 1 or the burning-days model whose skill passed rule 2. Both are recorded here; neither is chosen by this run.
